corpus.note: wasm3: the `-jit`/`-exe` path makes no tail calls — daslang's LLVM backend never emits sibling calls, so every executed wasm opcode costs a native frame — while the AOT C++ gets them from `clang++ -O3`; hence aot ahead of jit/exe here ([lookibed/daScript#4](https://github.com/lookibed/daScript/issues/4), `docs/followups/translator_gaps_wasm3.md`).
